og_title: Terms and Conditions | LottosOnline Festive Giveaway Offer
og_description: Please read our Terms and Conditions for participating in the Fesitve Giveaway Offer.

copy.html:
1. The LottosOnline.com Fesitve Giveaway is operated by Marvicap Ltd, Archangelou 48, Office 207, 2nd floor, Engomi, 2404, Nicosia, Cyprus. Company Registration Number HE 336864.
  2. The Festive Giveaway (the promotion) runs from Monday 1st December 2025 at 00:01 GMT until Wednesday 31st December 2025 at 23:59 GMT (the promotion period).
  3. The promotion is open to all registered customers of LottosOnline.com. Customers will be allocated one entry for each each individual lottery line, raffle decimo or syndicate share which has been successfully ordered and confirmed.
  4. Additional bonus entries may be granted periodically during the promotion. Notification and details regarding these bonus entries will be sent directly to participants via the registered LottosOnline email address.
  5. No entry will be issued without a corresponding purchase.
  6. The full list of available prizes is shown on the Festive Giveaway offer page.
  7. Entries are non-transferrable and have no cash value.
  8. Once the promotion has ended all participants will be notified by email confirming the number of entries accumulated during the promotion period. This email will be sent to their registered Lottosonline email address and will be generated no later than Tuesday, 6 January 2025, 23:59 GMT.
  9. Winners will be selected at random no later than Friday, 9 January 2025, 23:59 GMT. Winners will be notified via email sent to their registered Lottosonline email address.
  10. The promotion has eight prize tiers. The top four are cash prizes with a Reward Balance uplift option, the bottom four are Reward Balance prizes only. All winnings will be paid directly into the winning customer's appropriate balance (Winnings Balance or Rewards Balance) within 24 hours of the prize selection. All winnings may be withdrawn or used in line with the existing rules for those balances (available for review on our main terms and conditions page). Winners of a cash prize will receive a confirmation email asking if they wish to exercise the uplift option. If we do not receive a response from the customer within 48 hours of sending the email, we will automatically apply the uplift value to the cash prize by default to maximise the value.
  11. LottosOnline reserves the right to publish limited information regarding promotion winners. This information will be strictly limited to the winner's initials, the prize amount won, and the country of residence.
  12. If you do not wish to participate in this promotion please send an email to [email protected] before the promotion period ends.
  13. LottosOnline reserves the right to terminate the account of any customer suspected of tampering with or otherwise attempting to abuse the offer or violating these terms and conditions. The decision of the Board of Directors of Marvicap Limited will be final in such incidents.
  14. LottosOnline reserves the right to modify, suspend, or withdraw the offer at any time for any reason.
  15. By participating in the offer, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to adhere to these terms and conditions.
  16. These terms and conditions will be governed by the laws of Cyprus and any dispute or interpretation relating to LottosOnline 7ill be determined in accordance with them. Players agree to solve any disagreement or dispute by mediation and thereafter arbitration and exhaust all other remedies before seeking recourse directly in the courts of Cyprus.
